title: 上部 凡尘问道 第11章 藏书阁禁书残页上部 凡尘问道 第12章 老乞丐疯话藏真相
content_zh:
第1节半柱香生死窗，锁灵阵破局
月凉如水，外门藏书阁的青瓦在夜色中泛着冷光，朱红大门上的“千机锁灵阵”流转着暗金色符文，每一次光芒闪烁都伴随着低沉的嗡鸣。
“巡逻修士换班只剩半柱香，”苏晚晴将青铜令牌按在掌心，指尖沁出冷汗，“令牌只能屏蔽第一层探查，核心禁制必须在阵法能量循环的间隙破解，一旦失误，我们会被瞬间锁在阁内。”
凌无妄凝视着大门上的符文，规则之眼全力运转，三条交织的能量轨迹在视野中清晰浮现“阵法按‘天、地、人’三节点循环，每刻钟有03秒能量空白期，现在倒计时——三、二、一！”
话音未落，他指尖弹出三缕灵力，精准击中三个节点的衔接处。苏晚晴同步将令牌嵌入门环，青光与暗金光符文碰撞，阵法瞬间停滞，大门无声滑开一道缝隙。
“快进！”凌无妄拽着苏晚晴闪身而入，身后的大门在踏入的瞬间闭合，阵法重新运转，仿佛从未被触动。
阁内弥漫着陈旧的书卷气息，高耸的书架直抵屋顶，月光透过窗棂在地面投下交错的影子。两人刚踏上楼梯，二楼便传来刻意压低的交谈声
“柳长老有令，重点盯防近期晋升的外门弟子，尤其是那个无灵根的凌无妄，一旦他触碰上古文献，立刻上报。”
“放心，**区的‘触灵禁’连内门弟子都破不了，他一个刚引气的杂役，纯属自寻死路。”
凌无妄心中一凛，规则之眼扫过二楼，两名黑衣修士正背对着楼梯巡逻，腰间令牌刻着“内门执法”四字，气息沉稳如渊。
“他们早就盯上我们了。”苏晚晴压低声音，“**区在三楼最内侧，必须穿过他们的巡逻范围，我们只有一次机会。”
凌无妄目光落在书架上的《基础符箓大全》上，突然有了主意“我去引开他们，你趁机上楼找《上古修士录》，半柱香后在阁后老槐树下汇合。”
“不行，太危险了！”苏晚晴刚要阻止，凌无妄已经抓起两本厚重的典籍，朝着楼梯另一侧掷去。
“哐当！”典籍落地的声响打破寂静，两名黑衣修士立刻转身“谁在那里？”
趁着两人注意力被吸引，凌无妄冲苏晚晴使了个眼色，自己则朝着反方向跑去，故意踢倒一排书架。苏晚晴咬了咬牙，快步冲上三楼。
第2节触灵禁拦路，残页隐秘辛
三楼的空气带着刺骨的威压，书架上的书籍都用玄铁锁链锁住，封面泛黄的古籍散发着淡淡的灵力波动。苏晚晴直奔最内侧的书架，果然看到一本封面破损的《上古修士录》，书脊上刻着的篆文已经模糊不清。
她伸手去拿，指尖刚触碰到书页，一道淡红色的光幕突然弹出，将她弹开数步，手臂传来灼烧般的疼痛。
【检测到触灵禁禁制需匹配破法者灵力波动才能解锁，强行触碰将触发神魂冲击】
苏晚晴捂着手臂，脸色苍白。就在这时，凌无妄气喘吁吁地冲了上来，身后传来黑衣修士的怒吼“别跑！站住！”

“怎么样？拿到了吗？”凌无妄一边关门抵住房门，一边问道。
“触灵禁拦着，我破不了！”苏晚晴急道，“他们快追上来了！”
凌无妄运转规则之眼，看向《上古修士录》周围的光幕，符文轨迹在视野中展开，核心与自己体内的灵力波动隐隐呼应。
“让开！”凌无妄推开苏晚晴，将手掌按在光幕上，运转“极简引气法”，灵力按照规则轨迹流转。
“嗡！”光幕剧烈波动，淡红色逐渐褪去，玄铁锁链自动脱落。凌无妄一把抓起《上古修士录》，拉着苏晚晴躲到书架后面。
房门被轰然撞开，两名黑衣修士冲了进来“人呢？刚才明明看到他们冲上来了！”
两人在三楼四处搜寻，脚步声越来越近。凌无妄和苏晚晴屏住呼吸，快速翻开《上古修士录》，却发现书页上的关键内容都被黑色墨汁涂抹，只留下零星的文字碎片。
“可恶！关键信息都被抹了！”苏晚晴咬牙。
凌无妄没有放弃，规则之眼全力运转，墨汁下的淡金色符文逐渐显现“我能看到残留符文，你记下来——‘破法者，窥天道之钥，掌规则修正之力’‘三万年劫，天道崩，墨规子窃权’‘飞升者，道果为饵，饲天道代行者’……”
每念出一句，苏晚晴的脸色就凝重一分。这些破碎的文字，彻底颠覆了她对修仙界的认知。
“道果为饵？难道飞升根本是骗局？”苏晚晴难以置信。
content_en:
Section 1: The half-column incense window of life and death, the soul-locking formation is broken
The moon is as cold as water, the green tiles of the outer library are glowing in the night, and the "Thousand Machine Locking Spirit Array" on the vermilion door is flowing with dark golden runes, and every flash of light is accompanied by a low hum.
"The patrolling monks only have half a stick of incense left after the shift." Su Wanqing pressed the bronze token in the palm of her hand, cold sweat broke out on her fingertips. "The token can only block the first layer of detection. The core restriction must be broken during the energy cycle of the formation. If we make a mistake, we will be locked in the pavilion instantly."
Ling Wuwang stared at the runes on the door. The Eye of Rules was operating at full strength. Three intertwined energy trajectories clearly appeared in his field of vision. "The formation cycles according to the three nodes of 'Heaven, Earth, and Man'. There is an energy blank period of 03 seconds every quarter of an hour. The countdown is now - three, two, one!"
Before he finished speaking, three rays of spiritual power popped out from his fingertips, accurately hitting the connection between the three nodes. Su Wanqing simultaneously embedded the token into the door knocker. The green light and dark golden light runes collided, the formation stopped instantly, and the door slid open silently.
"Quickly move forward!" Ling Wuwan pulled Su Wanqing in and dodged in. The door behind him closed the moment he stepped in, and the formation started to operate again, as if it had never been touched.
The pavilion is filled with the smell of old books. The towering bookshelves reach up to the roof. The moonlight shines through the window lattice and casts interlaced shadows on the ground. As soon as the two stepped onto the stairs, the sound of deliberately lowered conversations could be heard from the second floor.
"Elder Liu has an order to keep an eye on the recently promoted outer disciples, especially Ling Wuwu, who has no spiritual roots. Once he comes into contact with ancient documents, report them immediately."
"Don't worry, even the inner disciples can't break the 'Spirit Touching Forbidden' in the ** area. He, a handyman who has just channeled his energy, is simply seeking his own death."
Ling Wuwang's heart trembled, and his eyes of rules swept across the second floor. Two monks in black were patrolling the stairs with their backs to the stairs. The tokens around their waists were engraved with the words "Inner Gate Law Enforcement", and their auras were as calm as an abyss.
"They have been targeting us for a long time." Su Wanqing lowered her voice, "The security area is at the innermost side of the third floor. We must pass through their patrol range. We only have one chance."
Ling Wuwang's eyes fell on the "Complete Collection of Basic Talismans" on the bookshelf, and he suddenly had an idea, "I'll lure them away, and you take the opportunity to go upstairs to find the "Records of Ancient Monks". After half a stick of incense, we meet under the old locust tree behind the pavilion."
"No, it's too dangerous!" Just as Su Wanqing was about to stop him, Ling Wuwang had already grabbed two heavy classics and threw them towards the other side of the stairs.
"Clang!" The sound of books falling to the ground broke the silence, and the two monks in black immediately turned around and asked, "Who is there?"
Taking advantage of the two people's attention being attracted, Ling Wuwu winked at Su Wanqing and ran in the opposite direction, deliberately kicking down a row of bookshelves. Su Wanqing gritted her teeth and rushed up to the third floor.
Chapter 2: Touching the spiritual forbidden road and blocking the road, the remaining pages hide the secrets
The air on the third floor carried a biting pressure. The books on the bookshelf were all locked with black iron chains, and the ancient books with yellowed covers exuded faint spiritual power fluctuations. Su Wanqing went straight to the innermost bookshelf and saw a book called "Ancient Monks' Records" with a damaged cover. The seal characters engraved on the spine of the book were blurred.
She reached out to pick it up, and as soon as her fingertips touched the page, a light red light curtain suddenly popped out, knocking her back a few steps, and she felt a burning pain in her arm.
[The detection of the soul-touching ban requires matching the spiritual power fluctuations of the spellbreaker to unlock it. Forcibly touching it will trigger the soul shock]
Su Wanqing covered her arms and looked pale. At this moment, Ling Wuwang rushed up panting, and behind him came the roar of the monk in black, "Don't run! Stop!"
"How's it going? Did you get it?" Ling Wuwang asked while closing the door.
"I can't break the Soul Touching Barrier!" Su Wanqing said anxiously, "They are almost catching up!"
Ling Wuwang turned his eyes of rules and looked at the light curtain around "Ancient Monk's Record". Rune tracks unfolded in his field of vision, and the core faintly echoed the fluctuations of spiritual power in his body.
"Get out of the way!" Ling Wuwang pushed Su awayWan Qing pressed her palm on the light screen and ran the "Minimalist Qi Entrainment Method", and the spiritual power flowed according to the rules.
"Buzz!" The light curtain fluctuated violently, the light red gradually faded, and the black iron chain fell off automatically. Ling Wuwang grabbed "Records of Ancient Monks" and pulled Su Wanqing to hide behind the bookshelf.
The door was slammed open, and two monks in black rushed in. "Where are the people? I saw them rushing up just now!"
The two searched around the third floor, and the footsteps got closer and closer. Ling Wuwang and Su Wanqing held their breaths and quickly opened the "Book of Ancient Monks", only to find that the key contents on the pages had been smeared with black ink, leaving only scattered fragments of text.
"Damn! All the key information has been erased!" Su Wanqing gritted her teeth.
Ling Wuwang did not give up, the Eye of Rules was operating at full strength, and the pale golden runes under the ink gradually appeared. "I can see the remaining runes, please write them down - 'Those who break the law, glimpse the key to the way of heaven, control the power of rule correction', 'Thirty thousand years of calamity, the way of heaven collapses, Mo Guizi steals the power', 'Those who ascend, use the Tao fruit as bait, feed the agents of the way of heaven'..."
Su Wanqing's face became more solemn every time she read a sentence. These broken words completely overturned her understanding of the world of immortality.
"Tao fruit is used as bait? Is the ascension a scam?" Su Wanqing couldn't believe it.
